games.title: Pitfall!
games.help: The stick runs and climbs; Fire jumps. Reset starts a new game.

games.title: Mike Tyson's Punch-Out!!
games.help: B is a left punch, A a right; Up with a punch goes to the face. Start throws a star punch when you have one.

games.title: Golden Axe
games.help: A is magic, B attacks, C jumps. A second gamepad joins as player 2.

games.title: Golden Axe (Master System)
games.help: Button 1 attacks, button 2 jumps; both together use magic.

games.title: Tetris (Game Boy)
games.help: Left and right move, Down drops faster, A and B turn the piece.

games.title: Ms. Pac-Man (Lynx)
games.help: Steer Ms. Pac-Man through the maze, eat every dot and stay away from the ghosts.

games.title: Pac-Man (Game Gear)
games.help: Steer with the d-pad; Start begins.

games.title: Prince of Persia
games.help: Arrows run, climb and crouch; Up jumps. Hold Shift to grab a ledge, step carefully or swing the sword.

games.title: The Oregon Trail
games.help: Pick from a list with its number, then Enter. Space goes on when the game asks you to press it. Type names and answers on the keyboard.

games.title: Super Mario World
games.help: B jumps, A spin-jumps, hold Y to run and carry.
